candidate.analysis: The program reads /input/public_csv, identifies the CSV format, computes fish-per-hour summary statistics, and reports grouped comparisons for livebait, camper, persons, child, and hours. It also fits an ordinary least-squares model for hourly catch rate using only the Python standard library, reporting coefficients and R-squared when enough valid observations are available.
candidate.answer: Visitors caught an average of 1.1074 fish per hour (median 0). Livebait and camper status were associated with higher rates, while the OLS model estimated positive effects for livebait, camper, and persons, and negative effects for child and hours; the model explained 10.85% of variance.
